title.en: Hydrogen Bonding in ortho- and para-Nitrophenol
title.hi: ऑर्थो- और पैरा-नाइट्रोफिनोल में हाइड्रोजन बांडिंग
title.hinglish: o- aur p-Nitrophenol mein Hydrogen Bonding

description.en: o-Nitrophenol exhibits intramolecular hydrogen bonding, leading to discrete molecules and lower boiling point (steam volatile). p-Nitrophenol exhibits intermolecular hydrogen bonding, leading to molecular association and a higher boiling point.
description.hi: o-नाइट्रोफिनोल अंतःअणुक हाइड्रोजन बांडिंग प्रदर्शित करता है, जिससे असतत (discrete) अणु बनते हैं और क्वथनांक कम होता है (भाप-वाष्पशील)। p-नाइट्रोफिनोल अंतर-आणविक हाइड्रोजन बांडिंग प्रदर्शित करता है, जिससे आणविक जुड़ाव होता है और क्वथनांक अधिक होता है।
description.hinglish: o-Nitrophenol intramolecular H-bonding dikhata hai, jisse separate molecules rehte hain aur boiling point low (steam volatile) hota hai. p-Nitrophenol intermolecular H-bonding dikhata hai, jisse molecules jud jate hain aur boiling point high hota hai.

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- o-Nitrophenol -->
  <g transform="translate(50, 50)">
    <text x="75" y="-20" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#374151" text-anchor="middle">o-Nitrophenol</text>
    <text x="75" y="-5" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280" text-anchor="middle">(Intramolecular H-bond)</text>

    <!-- Hexagon Ring -->
    <polygon points="50,20 100,20 125,63 100,106 50,106 25,63" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <!-- Double bonds -->
    <line x1="55" y1="30" x2="95" y2="30" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="115" y1="65" x2="95" y2="95" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="45" y1="95" x2="35" y2="65" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />

    <!-- OH Group -->
    <line x1="100" y1="20" x2="120" y2="-10" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="115" y="-15" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#111827">O</text>
    <line x1="135" y1="-20" x2="150" y2="-20" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="155" y="-15" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#111827">H</text>

    <!-- NO2 Group -->
    <line x1="125" y1="63" x2="150" y2="63" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="155" y="68" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#111827">N</text>
    <!-- N=O -->
    <line x1="170" y1="55" x2="185" y2="35" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="175" y1="60" x2="190" y2="40" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="190" y="35" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
    <!-- N->O -->
    <line x1="165" y1="75" x2="175" y2="95" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
    <text x="175" y="110" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444">O</text>

    <!-- Intramolecular H-bond -->
    <line x1="160" y1="-10" x2="185" y2="20" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
  </g>

  <!-- Divider -->
  <line x1="300" y1="20" x2="300" y2="280" stroke="#d1d5db" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />

  <!-- p-Nitrophenol -->
  <g transform="translate(350, 50)">
    <text x="125" y="-20" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="bold" fill="#374151" text-anchor="middle">p-Nitrophenol</text>
    <text x="125" y="-5" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#6b7280" text-anchor="middle">(Intermolecular H-bond)</text>

    <!-- Molecule 1 -->
    <g transform="translate(0, 40)">
      <polygon points="50,20 100,20 125,63 100,106 50,106 25,63" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      <circle cx="75" cy="63" r="35" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      
      <!-- OH Group -->
      <line x1="25" y1="63" x2="-10" y2="63" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      <text x="-25" y="68" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#111827">H-O</text>

      <!-- NO2 Group -->
      <line x1="125" y1="63" x2="160" y2="63" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      <text x="165" y="68" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#111827">N</text>
      <line x1="180" y1="55" x2="195" y2="40" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      <text x="195" y="35" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
      <line x1="180" y1="75" x2="195" y2="90" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      <text x="195" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Molecule 2 -->
    <g transform="translate(0, 160)">
      <polygon points="50,20 100,20 125,63 100,106 50,106 25,63" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      <circle cx="75" cy="63" r="35" fill="none" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      
      <!-- OH Group -->
      <line x1="25" y1="63" x2="-10" y2="63" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      <text x="-25" y="68" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#111827">H-O</text>

      <!-- NO2 Group -->
      <line x1="125" y1="63" x2="160" y2="63" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      <text x="165" y="68" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#111827">N</text>
      <line x1="180" y1="55" x2="195" y2="40" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      <text x="195" y="35" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
      <line x1="180" y1="75" x2="195" y2="90" stroke="#1d4ed8" stroke-width="2" />
      <text x="195" y="105" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#ef4444">O</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Intermolecular H-bond -->
    <line x1="205" y1="135" x2="-20" y2="220" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,4" />
    <text x="40" y="150" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#10b981">H-bond connects to next molecule...</text>
  </g>
</svg>
